_about: Pinned problem sets. A set is pinned by its hash (sorted problem ids). The Lab compares each CSV with its pin and warns when they differ. To change a pinned set, add a new entry with a new name and a written reason; never edit an entry in place.

frozen-30.note: Frozen set for the current phase: each reported configuration is measured once, 30 problems x 3 repeats. Failures are not read to choose agent changes.

dev-12.note: Development set: failures may be read to choose agent changes. Disjoint from frozen-30. See dev-12.md.
